The '''Anx Minor system''' was situated in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]], a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] lay on the [[Veragi Trade Route/Legends|Veragi Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Sinsang system/Legends|Sinsang system]] and the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector's]] [[Ord Trasi system/Legends|Ord Trasi system]]. Anx Minor was also connected via another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route to<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Gamer7">{{GamerCite|7|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Anx}}</ref> [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]],<ref name="TEA" /> which was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that had at one point [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] adjacent systems in the region known as [[Anx Space]].<ref name="Gamer7" /> The Anx Minor system contained an astronomical object of the [[Anx Minor/Legends|same name]].<ref name="TEA" />

Between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Anx Minor system fell within the borders of the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. That faction was then absorbed by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], which controlled the territory surrounding Anx Minor until [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Third Fleet|forces]] [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|commanded]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] [[Battle of Anx Minor|engaged]] and defeated at Anx Minor an Imperial Remnant force led by Admiral [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Anx Minor system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-4.<ref name="TEA" />
